title: LoRA & Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning — Quantize the Frozen Base
key_insight: QLoRA combines a quantized base with trainable low-rank adapters, while sensitive calculations use safer precision where needed.
body:
## Quantize the Frozen Base

Even frozen weights consume device memory. Storing them in fewer bits leaves more room for activations and adapter training.

QLoRA combines a quantized base with trainable low-rank adapters, while sensitive calculations use safer precision where needed.

Quantization saves memory but adds kernels and approximation error. Measure training stability, throughput, and final quality on the deployment hardware.
common_mistakes: LoRA retrains every base parameter by definition.
An adapter works with any unrelated base model.
Lower precision can never affect speed or quality.

real_world_usage: Parameter-efficient tuning makes adaptation possible with less training memory and smaller task-specific artifacts.
